**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must secure a legally binding prohibition before it is built.

2. We believe the stakes are stark: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and a catastrophe killing at least a billion people will follow. We need a legally binding prohibition on its development.

3. We cannot build superintelligent AI safely. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are working for a legally binding ban.

**(b) Newsletter opening (107 words)**

We face a defining choice. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We cannot make this technology safe: no one knows how to build superintelligence without risking human extinction. The consequences would reach far beyond any one country, company, or generation. That is why we are working for a legally binding prohibition on developing superintelligence—not voluntary promises, not vague safeguards, but a clear and enforceable ban. We must act before development begins, while the choice is still ours. In this newsletter, we share what we are doing to build the public and political support needed to make that prohibition real.
